title: Implantable Automatic Defibrillators (ICDs)
description: CMS coverage policy for primary and secondary prevention implantable cardioverter defibrillators. Mandates documented severe systolic dysfunction (LVEF <= 35%), NYHA Class II/III functional symptoms, optimal GDMT for >= 90 days, post-MI waiting period > 40 days, and absence of cardiogenic shock.

criteria.name: Severe LV Systolic Dysfunction
criteria.description: Documented Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction (LVEF) <= 35% on diagnostic echocardiography or cardiac MRI.

criteria.name: Heart Failure Functional Classification
criteria.description: Patient classified as New York Heart Association (NYHA) Class II or Class III functional symptoms.

criteria.name: Guideline-Directed Medical Therapy Duration
criteria.description: Patient has received optimal guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) including beta-blocker and ACEi/ARB/ARNI for >= 90 days.
criteria.clinical_intent: Ensure medical therapy trial before invasive device

criteria.name: Cardiomyopathy Etiology & Revascularization Timeline
criteria.description: Ischemic cardiomyopathy >= 40 days post-MI or >= 90 days post-CABG/PCI, or non-ischemic dilated cardiomyopathy >= 9 months.
criteria.clinical_intent: Enforce mandatory myocardial stunning recovery period

criteria.name: Cardiogenic Shock & Acute Ischemia Exclusion
criteria.description: Patient must not have active cardiogenic shock, ongoing acute cardiac ischemia, or non-cardiac disease limiting life expectancy to < 1 year.
